title: VTA Events — Cancel — payload
description: A client cancels a published event: it takes no more registrations, its registrants' receipts stand, and every invitation's notification is withdrawn. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Shown to invitees with the event.
